<a id="ScenarioData"></a>

### What the library's scenarios are given

`ScenarioData` · `src/scenarios.ts:114`

Two seeds and a text; how many numbers to draw, between which bounds; items and their weights; a preference and a value; a sentence and its language; the seconds turned; a file, its text and its copy; a page, a selector, a text, an error.

| Case | Value |
|---|---|
| seeds | 1, 2 |
| text | a seed |
| draws | 200 |
| bounds | { lo: 1, hi: 6 } |
| weighted | { item: light, weight: 1 }, { item: heavy, weight: 3 }, { item: never, weight: 0 } |
| never | never |
| preference | { name: voice, value: off, unset: pace } |
| sentence | { text: Breathe in, language: en } |
| turned | 0.5, 0.25 |
| file | { path: dist/page.html, text: <p>a page</p>, copy: public/index.html } |
| page | { path: dist/page.html, selector: .poses li, count: 12, text: Mountain, error: The page broke, language: fr } |
| command | SELECT 1 |
| repository | { name: owner/project, settings: { branch: main, checks: project, library, upToDate: false, approvals: 1, method: merge, autoMerge: true, deletesMerged: true, pages: true }, left: { methods: merge, squash, autoMerge: false, deletesMerged: true, protected: false, checks: library, upToDate: false }, differs: methods, autoMerge, protected, approvals, checks } |
